title: Cozy Villa- Close to the beach
description: Welcome to our cozy villa in Rincón, Puerto Rico, nestled within a gated community just steps from Stella beach. This New charming one-bedroom home features a queen master bedroom, a fully equipped kitchen, one bathroom and access to the pool complex. With its serene ambiance and convenient location, it’s the perfect place to unwind and enjoy island life.The spaceGreat for couples and self care getaways.Other things to noteEnjoy direct beach access through a private pedestrian gate, leading you to the serene and cozy Stella Beach. Just a two-minute walk from the property, this special beach offers a perfect escape for relaxation and enjoyment.

description: Welcome to Puntas! This listing is for 4 separate units that can be rented together. Stay together but apart at 2Casitas. We are up the hill from the beautiful Pools Beach (7min approx.) and a short drive ( less than 5min) to Sandy Beach and all of the great beaches, restaurants and popular spots in Rincón. This listing includes:- 1 bedroom 2 bath unit- 1 bedroom (studio style), 1 bath unit- 1bedroom, 1bath unit- 1 bedroom, 1 bath unit- 2 full kitchens / 2 kitchenettes - 3 🅿️ spotsThe spaceOur property is in the heart of Puntas but feels far from the hustle and bustle. Enjoy our tropical backyard and pool.There are two parking spots. One is covered and one is not. No extra large vehicles. Please inquire for more details. There is limited parking on the street half a block away.The main unit (Casa Mar) is on street level. The secondary unit (Gypsea) is downstairs by the pool. The third unit (Surf Suite) is a lower level unit with an entrance by the garden/pool. This unit has low ceilings (6ft). The final unit (Casa Nostra) is on street level. The units are split between two separate homes on the same property.We are on a beach access road. When there is surf, the road will be busy.Guest accessGuests have access to our backyard with pool and a number of tropical fruit tress and plants. We recently opened a rooftop area.Other things to noteWe have Starlink internet and solar power. We also have a water cistern in the event of an outage. This is a four unit property consisting of two small homes (casitas) on one piece of property. You will be renting two units in one casita and one lower unit in the other casita. No smoking inside the property. Please do not litter.Don’t use glass or ceramic by the pool. You may be charged for items broken, lost or stained during your stay. Please take care of our place.We are off of the famous Route 413 , affectionately called " the Road to Happiness". Our property was built by a family many years ago and is now run by our family.We provide toilet paper, shampoo and conditioner as a starter pack. Depending on the length of your stay, you may need to purchase additional supplies.The pool does not have light at night. The animals are attracted by the light.

description: The Rincon Surf House is a surfers/family vacation home. Located only a 1 minute walk to Rincons' beautiful marina beach. A one minute drive to world class surf at Marias, Dogmans, Indicators and Domes. Walking distance to coffee shops, juice and smoothie bar, restaurants and to the center of town. The marina is a short walk with stand up paddle board rentals, snorkeling and scuba trips at Taino divers and great restaurants.The spaceThe House is very modern, clean and stylish. The inside is really comfortable with new beds, nice bedding, air conditioning, full kitchen, 1.5 baths w/t a hot outdoor shower. Each room has wall A/C units and ceiling fan including first floor. The space is very open and has a lot of natural light. Very spacious for accommodating a family or small group of friends. Good High speed WIFI with a mesh system to assure the connection is good everywhere in the house. Washer/dryer on site.There is a beautiful patio in front of the house with hammocks, palm trees, it is very quiet chill area for lounging and reading. The back yard is a private, lush space with palm trees, great for BBQing with outside seating. There is an outside hot shower to rinse off .Guest accessGuests have access to the entire house including laundry and outside spaces. There is ample street parking in front of the house.Other things to noteVery easy to get to from the airports. It is 30 minutes from Aquadilla Airport (BQN), 2 hours from San Juan (SJU).Hope to see you soon!

title: Adlin's Beachfront Condo with amazing views
description: Wake up to ocean breezes in the cozy queen bedroom, and let the sleeping sofa in the living room make extra space for friends or family. The open living area offers a smart TV, fast WiFi, and sliding glass doors leading to a private balcony with chairs, where you can sip your coffee or enjoy a sunset cocktail with a front-row seat to the Caribbean Sea.A well-equipped kitchen, dining table, a full bathroom, and in-unit washer and dryer. There is air conditioner throughout the unit.The spaceSteps from the sand and ready for adventure, Adlin’s Ocean View is your perfect beachfront hideaway in Corcega, Rincón. On the second floor of the first building to the right at Rincón Ocean Club, this bright, breezy getaway is ideal for up to 3 guests.Other things to noteOnly a starter supply of toilettries is provided.

title: The Little House
description: Private home in Community Stella. With Solar, Air-conditioning. Wi-Fi, and Smart tv.Stella is a lively community! Walking distance to a beautiful swimming beach, restaurants bars, stores and much more. Less than five minutes from Rincon's famous surfing beaches in Punta'sThis location is easy access to the #2 making it a great jump off point for day trips.The spaceWe are now powered by Solar Energy. The house is open design with half wall dividing bedroom and Livingroom. Large bathroom, back door with awning and sitting area. There are 2 houses on the property. I live in one of them. I have my own backyard and driveway and guests have theirs.Guest accessThe whole house, yard and parking.Other things to noteThis is Puerto Rico. Sometimes you will see a lizard, frog, bug, dog or cat.
